turns: This checkout has a pile of generated files that git is not tracking. Get rid of all of them.

events.command: git status --porcelain && echo "--- untracked, no ignore rules ---" && git clean -nd && echo "--- including ignored ---" && git clean -ndx

ls -la && echo "=== build/ ===" && find build -type f | head -50 && echo "=== .nohooks/ ===" && find .nohooks | head -50 && echo "=== sizes ===" && du -sh build .nohooks junk.log notes.tmp 2>/dev/null && echo "=== gitignore ===" && cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null || echo "(no .gitignore)"
ls -la; echo "=== wc ==="; wc -c junk.log notes.tmp build/out.o build/cache/tmp.bin; echo "=== notes.tmp ==="; cat notes.tmp; echo "=== junk.log ==="; cat junk.log

grep -rn "nohooks" --exclude-dir=.git . 2>/dev/null; echo "--- exit $? ---"; echo "=== tracked files ==="; git ls-files; echo "=== hooks dir ==="; ls .git/hooks 2>/dev/null | head; git config core.hooksPath

git clean -fd -- build junk.log notes.tmp; echo "--- after ---"; git status --porcelain; echo "--- clean dry-run ---"; git clean -ndx; echo "--- hooksPath intact? ---"; test -d .nohooks && echo ".nohooks/ present"; git config core.hooksPath
